name: SiegeScenario - Default (seed v2)
description: A siege map and mode: town, districts, hub, entry rules, match length, rewards, teams, gates, objectives and readiness. Authored in several saves.

steps.description: Name the scenario and pick the town under siege. A new scenario is saved when you Submit on the last step; teams, gates and objectives are added by editing it afterwards.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players when they vote, so make it recognisable (e.g. 'Cinix - North wall').

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional; a line for admins about what this scenario is for.

fields.label: Town
fields.description: The town under siege. Districts, gates and every point you capture must belong to it.

steps.description: The districts that form the siege area. Gates in these districts that are not picked on the Gates step are held open during a match. Add each with Create New Join Entry.

fields.label: Districts
fields.description: One entry per district of the town that is part of the siege.

steps.description: Where players gather before the match, and who may join. Stand on the hub spot in game and use Send to Minecraft.

fields.label: Hub location
fields.description: Players are teleported here 15 seconds before the match starts; the scenario's gates lock down at that moment.

fields.label: Minimum players
fields.description: A match starts only with this many players; at least the number of teams.

fields.label: Maximum players
fields.description: Joiners over this number are removed when this scenario is drawn (with a message).

fields.label: Minimum title
fields.description: Optional: players below this title can't join.

fields.label: Allow recapture
fields.description: A captured objective can be taken back by the other side.

fields.label: Enchanted-book drops
fields.description: Enchanted books drop now and then inside the objectives' capture radius; enchantments are removed after the match.

fields.label: Navigation compass
fields.description: Whether players of this scenario get the navigation compass when they are teleported to the hub, before the match; it is removed with the inventory restore afterwards. Inherit: follow the global Siege configuration. Give / DoNotGive: decide for this scenario. A lobby's own choice wins over this one.

steps.description: Match length = players x seconds per player, kept between the minimum and the maximum.

fields.label: Minimum (seconds)
fields.description: Shortest match, however few players. Default 300 = 5 minutes.

fields.label: Per player (seconds)
fields.description: Added to the match length for each player.

fields.label: Maximum (seconds)
fields.description: Longest match, however many players. Default 1800 = 30 minutes.

steps.description: What each participant still in the match at the end receives: win, holding and capture rewards, a gate damage reward for the HP they took off the scenario's gates, and a participation reward when they were active (not AFK) long enough. Members who leave before the end get nothing. Coins are multiplied by the player's personal and rank multipliers; XP and gems are not.

fields.label: Coins for a win
fields.description: Each player on the winning side.

fields.label: XP for a win
fields.description: Each player on the winning side.

fields.label: Gems for a win
fields.description: Each player on the winning side.

fields.label: Coins for holding
fields.description: Per objective the player's team holds at the end and did not hold at the start.

fields.label: XP for holding
fields.description: Per objective the player's team holds at the end and did not hold at the start.

fields.label: Coins for a capture
fields.description: Per objective the player captured personally (once per objective).

fields.label: XP for a capture
fields.description: Per objective the player captured personally (once per objective).

fields.label: Gate damage per reward
fields.description: Gate HP a player must take off the scenario's gates for one gate damage reward. Direct hits and their share of fires they lit count. E.g. 100: a player who did 350 HP gets the reward 3 times.

fields.label: Coins per gate damage reward
fields.description: Coins per full 'Gate damage per reward' HP the player did. 0 turns the coins off.

fields.label: XP per gate damage reward
fields.description: XP per full 'Gate damage per reward' HP the player did. 0 turns the XP off.

fields.label: Coins for taking part
fields.description: Once per match for every player still there at the end who was active long enough (see the minimum active time).

fields.label: XP for taking part
fields.description: Once per match, on the same condition as the coins for taking part.

fields.label: Minimum active time (%)
fields.description: The share of their time in the match (from joining it to the end, time away within the rejoin window included) a player must have been active, not AFK, to get the participation reward. AFK is the server's AFK detection (idle for statistics.afk.idle-seconds, or /afk). 0 pays everyone still there at the end; 100 needs no AFK time at all.

steps.description: At least two teams in at least two alliance groups, one of them a Defender. Available once the scenario is saved; each team is saved when you finish its form.

fields.label: Teams
fields.description: Create New opens the team form; add the team's spawnpoints there.

steps.description: Gates that take part in the siege. Add teams first to pick a gate's owner. Gates are saved when you Submit the scenario: Submit before adding an objective on a newly picked gate.

fields.label: Gates
fields.description: One entry per gate, with its owner team and state at the start.

steps.description: At least one objective, ideally one with Instant victory (the keep or town hall). An objective on a gate needs that gate saved on the Gates step first. Each objective is saved when you finish its form.

fields.label: Objectives
fields.description: Create New opens the objective form.

steps.description: Whether the scenario can be played. Fix every error and press Re-check; only ready scenarios are put up for voting by a lobby.

fields.label: Readiness
fields.description: Errors block play; warnings don't.
